title: The Pale Cellar
author: Theo Underhill
blurb: Juniper Oyelaran, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
